subject: [AMBER] moving water away from a residue

messages.author: German P. Barletta
messages.body:
Hi!
A bit of an odd question, but perhaps someone has done this before:
say I want to instantly mutate a residue (without performing FEP), without
the new residue clashing with any water molecule. How could I go about it?
Is there a better way than finding the lining water molecules, applying
some pull away from the residue and running a few steps before doing the
mutation?
Thanks for any help!
